title: Predict: When deinit Runs
hints: An object is freed when its **last** strong reference goes away — immediately.
`a = nil` doesn't free A because `b` still holds it; reassigning `b` does.
jsBridge: ARC releases an object the moment its last strong reference disappears, so the order of `deinit` output follows your code exactly. JS GC timing is unobservable. This predictability is why retain cycles matter so much in Swift.
